plans.starter: Starter · £99 + £25/mo. Your colours, type and logo on this design: the gelato wall and today's counter from a sheet you edit on your phone (what's left, what's back tomorrow, and a line from the kitchen), the menu with every allergen and the eggless, vegan and halal filters, open late with last orders and seats, delivery links, questions and a Plan your visit page.
plans.plus: Plus · £199 + £30/mo. Up to five pages including home: the full menu with the allergen chart, celebration cakes with the earliest date and a request on WhatsApp, collection orders, private hire with a guest calculator, deposits by your own Stripe links, gift vouchers, take-home tubs, boxes by post, a box a month, favour boxes by the hundred, and the flavour vote your customers answer every week.
plans.signature: Signature · £349 + £35/mo. Up to 20 pages, plus the showpieces: the box (choose every piece, tie the ribbon, write the card, send it as a gift with its own link), the tasting flight, your seal on the favour boxes, the advent box, and something made just for your shop.

gate.plus: Starter is a full home page plus Plan your visit. Plus adds up to four more pages, like this one: the full menu, celebration cakes and private hire, and the weekly flavour vote.
